description: Grasp opposite outer sides of the yellow nut, lift it over the white bolt, align the nut's hole with the bolt axis, and lower until the bolt enters the hole. The hand then opens and retreats slightly. The nut subsequently rotates/descends in the images while the recorded hand remains nearly stationary and open. This is a useful grasp/alignment/seating reference, but it is not evidence of a demonstrated active multi-turn wrist-screwing controller. Verify progress in the current environment instead of assuming the post-release behavior will recur.
